description: This PHP file defines the view class 'AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart' for rendering a Gantt chart interface within the SuiteCRM project, including resource management, task creation pop-ups, and project timeline calculations.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart
classes.description: A view class for displaying and managing a Gantt chart for project templates, including resource linking and task pop-ups.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart view, including resource management, task creation dialogs, and project timeline setup.

methods.name: time_range
